nodes.label: action-build-notes
nodes.tldr: The reusable GitHub Action every notes repo calls from publish.yml: builds the image, pushes it to ghcr.io and commits the new pin to notes-gitops for test.

nodes.label: notes-api
nodes.tldr: The Go HTTP API behind notes-web and notes-cli. It owns the notes-db Postgres database, validates Auth0 tokens, and publishes a note-events message to RabbitMQ for every change so notes-worker can send notifications.

nodes.label: notes-cli
nodes.tldr: The Rust CLI customers run on their own machines. It syncs a local folder of markdown notes with notes-api over HTTPS and keeps a local SQLite cache of what was synced. Shipped as release binaries with an install script.

nodes.label: notes-core
nodes.deploy: Go module on GitHub (tag v*), consumed by go.mod
nodes.tldr: The Go module shared by notes-api, notes-worker and notes-cli: the note model, validation rules and the note-events message schema. Published as a Go module by tag; no runtime of its own.

nodes.label: notes-docs
nodes.deploy: GitHub Pages at docs.notes.example via deploy.yml
nodes.tldr: The Astro documentation site for customers, published to GitHub Pages on every merge to main. It documents the web app, the CLI and the API.

nodes.label: notes-gitops
nodes.tldr: The gitops repository Flux polls. One overlay per cluster under apps/<env>/ lists the applications and pins their image versions; action-build-notes commits the pins.

nodes.label: notes-installer
nodes.deploy: GitHub Release assets (install.sh) + Docker Hub image notesco/installer
nodes.tldr: The install script and a small image that download the right notes-cli release binary from GitHub Releases and put it on PATH. Shipped by cutting a release.

nodes.label: notes-web
nodes.tldr: A SvelteKit single-page app served from its own container. It calls notes-api over HTTPS for everything and holds no data of its own. Logins go through Auth0 and the API validates the token.

nodes.label: notes-worker
nodes.tldr: The Go worker that consumes note-events from RabbitMQ and sends share notifications and daily digests over SMTP. It reads notes-db for digest content and never writes to it.

nodes.label: env:Live
nodes.role: The customer-facing cluster, promoted from test by a release PR.

nodes.label: env:Test
nodes.role: The test cluster. Every merge to main rolls here first.

nodes.label: ghcr.io
nodes.role: The org container registry; images are tagged by commit sha.

nodes.label: Flux
nodes.role: Polls notes-gitops and reconciles the pinned versions onto each cluster.

nodes.label: Docs site
nodes.role: The documentation site on GitHub Pages, published by its repo's own workflow.

nodes.label: store:postgres:notes-db
nodes.role: The Postgres database holding notes, users and the event outbox.

nodes.label: RabbitMQ
nodes.role: The message broker carrying note events from the API to the worker.

nodes.label: Auth0
nodes.role: The identity provider; the web app and the API validate its tokens.

flows.name: Publish a note
flows.summary: How a note typed in the web app becomes an email in a collaborator's inbox.

steps.title: Save the note
steps.detail: The web app sends the note to the API over HTTPS. Nothing is stored in the browser.

steps.title: Write it down and announce it
steps.detail: The API writes notes-db and publishes one note-events message through the outbox.

steps.title: Pick the event up
steps.detail: The worker consumes the event and decides who needs to hear about it.

steps.title: Send the mail
steps.detail: The worker sends the share notification through the SMTP relay.
